# Repository Instructions
- This repository contains the normative Python 3.12 reference implementation for BIP ChillDKG (`python/chilldkg_ref/`).
- Do not modify files in `python/chilldkg_ref/` or `vectors/` unless explicitly requested.
- Run `./all.sh` (or `pytest`) to validate all changes before opening a Pull Request.
- Always open a draft PR with explicit risk notes and test results; never push directly to `master`.
